messages:
Alice M: DeployBot just started the v2 rollout to gateway cluster. Noticed the deploy changed rate-limit headers to `x-rate-limit-mode: strict` for v2 traffic. Can we confirm this was intentional?
DeployBot: started canary rollout: v2 -> 10% traffic -> gateway-eu-a, gateway-us-west-b. Release ID: r-2026-03-20-42.
Ben K: I didn't expect strict mode. Our client libs rely on the soft/fallback header to gracefully back off. If strict is on, mobile SDK will get 429s immediately.
Carla R: Oof — that's a problem. The deploy PR (D1234) mentioned a rate-limit refactor but not a semantic change. @Ben K can you verify Mobile SDK behavior?
Mobile SDK: Quick check — with strict semantics the SDK retries less and surfaces 429 to app. User-facing errors increase. We should pin mobile clients to v1 or apply header compatibility.
Alice M: Rolling back is quick if we need. What's telemetry saying so far?
SRE Oncall: Metrics: request success 99.96% for v2 canary so far but 429 rate spiked from 0.02% -> 0.9% on a couple of mobile-only routes (profile sync, notifications). Latency stable.
Ben K: Given user-facing 429s, suggest two options: 1) Pause canary and revert the rate-limit mode change; 2) Patch gateway to honor legacy `x-rl-fallback: true` when client sends `x-client-version: v1`. Which is faster?
Carla R: Gateway patch will take ~30min inc. CI, canary, smoke. Full rollback is ~7min (revert canary toggle) + verify. If we pause, DeployBot can stop traffic shift immediately.
Alice M: I vote pause + rollback of the specific header change, keep other v2 bits live. We don't want to halt the whole rollout if it's just one header.
DeployBot: pausing rollout per request from Alice M. Current canary traffic frozen at 10%.
Ben K: If we rollback header change, we should also cut a small follow-up PR to document `x-rate-limit-mode` semantics and add integration test in mobile SDK.
SRE Oncall: I'll keep monitoring. If 429s exceed 1.5% or error budget for mobile route breaches, we initiate full rollback.
Carla R: I'll open rollback PR now and tag infra for quick review. Patch will revert to `x-rate-limit-mode: permissive` for v2 clients, and add header compatibility mapping.
Alice M: Thanks. After rollback, let's create a short release note blurb and coordinate with SDK team for a pinned client header until we patch. Also add a canary-specific alert for header semantic changes. :eyes:
Mobile SDK: We'll add a temporary client-side pin: send `x-api-version: v1` for any mobile < 2.0.3 to avoid sudden 429s. Will follow up with PR.
DeployBot: rollback PR r-2026-03-20-42-rollback submitted by Carla R. CI started.
Ben K: Once rollback is merged, please run a quick canary recheck (5% for 10min) before resuming full rollout.
SRE Oncall: Noted. I'll run smoke after merge and watch the mobile routes.
Alice M: Great work team. Follow-up tasks: Carla open rollback PR, Ben add SDK test and pin, SRE monitor, Mobile SDK PR. We'll reconvene in thread when CI finishes. :thumbsup:
